walkthrough.title: Count which colour sits in which target zone. Swap mismatched pairs directly first; whatever is left forms 3-way cycles that need 2 swaps each.

steps.text: Target zones: 1 zeros, then 1 ones, then 1 twos.
Pairs that can swap straight into place: 0 swaps.
3 balls remain in 1 three-way cycle, 2 swaps each. Total 2.
